name: Legionarius

// upper body while the legs walk); in reach it stabs past the shield or bashes, then raises it again.
// Damage comes from the clips' hit events, so the CustomNPCs melee swing is cancelled.
function engaged(npc) { var t = npc.getAttackTarget(); return t != null && t.isAlive(); }
